label: SCG I.22 contingent union omissions and stable distinct alternative
paraphrase: Seven two-world, two-principle interpretations: a positive necessary esse with contingent accidental attachment of a rejected proposed quiddity distinct from its represented actual essence, omissions of each of three interpretive premises, a non-esse-identical bearer, a nonnecessary esse, and a necessary stable attachment to a genuinely different quiddity represented as the actual essence. All the relevant positive/omission fields have nonempty actual extensions. These are finite signature facts, not evidence of metaphysical possibility or the actual truth/falsity of an OPEN premise.
